posts.title: What Carries Us Through: Three Pieces, Twenty Years

posts.title: New Work: Atiihkuw (ᐊᑎᐧᑯᐤ)
posts.description: A new piece is live on the site. Atiihkuw (ᐊᑎᐧᑯᐤ) is the word for caribou in the Naskapi language. I drew this by hand, inspired by a photo by the incredible Mark Raycroft. The stars in the background are accurate, showing the actual winter constellations of the northern hemisphere. The border patterns were modeled from […]

posts.title: New Show at Sam’s Bagels in Catonsville, MD
posts.description: I just finished hanging 15 portraits at Sam’s Bagels in Catonsville, Maryland, and I recorded a timelapse of the whole process.
